title: 第73章 百姓？不过是奴隶罢了！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 太子很愤怒，这次国债风波，牵扯了他手底下的很多官员。大家都不想还钱，都哭着没钱，他能怎么办？自己的臂膀，只能自己护着。顾城虽然不是他授意杀的，但做假账的顾城死了，你好我好大家好。唐逸这废物，现在凑什么热闹！“殿下，奴才刚想禀报您呢，苏千户刚从顾府出来，就直接来东宫了，现在正在外面等候。”洪竹恭敬说道。“让他滚进来！”太子一挥手，冷声喝道。洪竹应了一声退了出去。很快，便将苏狂带进了大殿。“苏狂，你最好给本宫解释清楚，宫里传出来的案子已破，是什么意思？”太子站在窗户前，目光盯着皇宫方向，声音冰冷无比。苏狂恭敬拱手道：“殿下放心，这不过是宁川和唐逸的障眼法罢了。”“按照殿下的意思，臣已经将现场全部破坏了。”“宁川和唐逸找不到任何线索，便说已经找到凶手了，臣弄得遍地狼藉的东西，全都是证据。”“他们是想打草惊蛇，让人去销毁他们所谓的罪证。”“到时候只要将人抓住了，那就是他们苦等的线索。”太子闻言脸上的冷峻迅速消散，嘴角重新挂上了浅笑。他当即转身抬手示意宁川坐下，道：“也就是说，这所谓的案子破了，不过是假消息是吧？”苏狂端起桌上的茶杯敬了一下太子，喝了口茶润了润喉，嘴角的笑容便变得狠戾起来。“殿下说得没错，是假的。”“这也说明宁川和唐逸，已经黔驴技穷了。”苏狂放下茶杯，恭敬拱手道：“恭喜殿下，我们什么都不用做，只等陛下给的破案期限一到，殿下便能一箭三雕。”“哦？哪三雕？”太子眼睛眯了起来。苏狂脸上充满自信，道：“一，扫除宁川，宁川是陛下的心腹，殿下将来想要掌控锦衣卫，宁川就必须死。”“二，殿下为群臣扫除了障碍，让群臣在户部的账成了呆账烂账，陛下想要查也无从查起，他们必定对殿下更加忠心。”“当然，最重要的是第三点。”苏狂笑容中带着自信和得意，道：“燕王萧棣。燕王萧棣在朝堂没有根基，但其军中支持者却甚多。”“而臣与一处有赌约，户部的案子谁先破了，对方就得围着城裸奔一圈。”“燕王要是脱光在城外裸奔一圈，那就是整个京都的笑话，皇族的耻辱。”“那他，将与那个位置再无半点关系。”太子手猛地一顿，杯中茶水溢出。他原本带着笑容的脸骤然僵硬，猛地看向苏狂，目光变得森冷而严厉，充斥着打量和审视。萧棣，虽然在朝中没有根基，但在军队中有很高的威望。如今拱卫京都的京军中，有很多将领都和他有关系，曾在边境和他一起杀过敌。现在，苏狂竟然说能毁了他？太子目光冷冽地盯着苏狂，苏狂脸上也带着笑容，冲着太子微微颔首。他从一开始，针对的就不是唐逸，而是燕王萧棣。唐逸，不过是顺带罢了。“殿下，你觉得以燕王殿下的性格，要是输了，他会赖账吗？”苏狂慢悠悠从怀中，取出了和一处签订的赌约。而现在，唐逸和萧棣都是一处的人。洪竹立即走上前，将契约接过送到了太子的桌案上。太子仔细看了赌约，眼底的冷意渐渐消散，甚至连心跳都不由加快了起来。如今在京中的皇子，数萧棣对他的威胁最大，只要铲除掉萧棣，九五之位就非他莫属了。而以萧策的性格，只要输了，定然不会赖账。一个在全京都百姓面前裸奔的皇族，会被礼法所不容，被宗庙所不齿，被百官所抛弃，他还有什么资格和他争？“要是老四输了，他定然是不会赖账的。”太子示意洪竹将契约还给苏狂，看向书狂道：“前提是，你先得告诉孤，凭什么你觉得你一定能赢？”苏狂将契约收了起来，道：“我已经找好了人证物证，证明就是原户部右侍郎因为还不起国库的巨额债务，买凶杀人。”“凶手，就是他在户部的部下。”太子端起茶杯轻抿一口，道：“柳公瑾洁身自好，这些年柳家也极为落魄，他所借的巨额债务做何用处？”苏狂笑道：“柳公瑾养有外室。外室是京都幻音阁有名的花魁梅香，刚好，这个女人和人做生意，亏得血本无归。”“柳公瑾为了贴补亏空，挪用户部公款。”太子笑着放下茶杯，道：“如此甚好，那就按照你所说的办吧！”“此事若办好了，孤重重有赏。”苏狂连忙站起来拱手道：“谢殿下，臣愿为殿下赴汤蹈火，在所不辞。”太子挥了挥手，苏狂转身离去。随即，太子重新回到琴案，指尖轻轻拨动琴弦。凌乱却又显得极为悠扬的琴声便在大殿上响起。这是他思考问题常用的方法，别人想问题都喜欢安静，他想事情的时候要是手里没有点东西，总觉得不自在。之前喜欢画画，只是天下女人何人能配得上他？因此那些画卷，也就只有妖娆的身姿，却没有脸。现在，他喜欢弹琴。铮！这时，太子手骤然一顿。原本悠扬的琴声骤然尖锐起来，也戛然而止。洪竹知道太子已有决断，躬身等候命令。“告诉刘温，他们该还钱了。”账面上是多少，还多少便是。国库没银子了，大不了加点赋税罢了。天下百姓说好听点是大炎的百姓，说难听点不过是他萧家的奴隶。奴隶，就该为主人奉献全部！……状元街，状元楼。今日休沐，刘温和朝中一群文臣，再度在状元街聚首。他们的目的，自然还是那个神出鬼没的小诗仙。只是派人蹲守了数日，依旧没有那小诗仙的任何消息。倒是他写的有几篇神作，又掀起了一阵风浪。“疏影横斜水清浅，暗香浮动月黄昏。”“多美的诗句，堪称呼千古咏梅绝句，这样的诗竟然用在一个女人的身上，真真是暴殄天物啊！”“云想衣裳花想容，春风拂槛露华浓……”“如此绝美诗句，竟然是给一个女婢写的？而且还不知道那个女婢是谁！”恨归恨，但此时看完唐逸的诗词，很多大臣都捶胸顿足，恼怒不已。多好的诗，多好的词，怎么就给了一个青楼女人呢？更恨的是……这么好的诗词，怎么就不是出自他们的手呢？这要是出自他们的手，必定名动京都，留名千史。
content_en: The prince was very angry. This national debt crisis had implicated many officials under him.No one wants to pay back the money and they all cry that they have no money. What can he do?He can only protect his own arms.Although Gu Cheng was not killed under his orders, Gu Cheng, who made false accounts, is dead. Hello, me, everyone.Tang Yi, this loser, why is he joining in the fun now!"Your Highness, I just wanted to report to you that Su Qianhu came directly to the East Palace as soon as he came out of the Gu Mansion and is now waiting outside." Hong Zhu said respectfully."Let him get out!" The prince waved his hand and shouted coldly.Hong Zhu responded and retreated.Soon, Su Kuang was brought into the hall."Su Kuang, you'd better explain to me clearly what it means that the case reported in the palace has been solved?" The prince stood in front of the window, staring in the direction of the palace, his voice was extremely cold.Su Kuang bowed his hands respectfully and said: "Your Highness, don't worry, this is just a deception by Ning Chuan and Tang Yi." "According to Your Highness's wishes, I have destroyed the entire scene." "Ning Chuan and Tang Yi couldn't find any clues, so they said they had found the murderer, and I made a mess everywhere.The things they borrowed were all evidence."They wanted to scare the snake away and let people destroy their so-called evidence.""As long as the person is caught, that will be the clue they have been waiting for."After hearing this, the coldness on the prince's face quickly disappeared, and a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth.He immediately turned around and raised his hand to signal Ning Chuan to sit down, and said, "In other words, this so-called case has been solved, but it is just false news, right?" Su Kuang picked up the teacup on the table and toasted the prince, took a sip of tea to moisten his throat, and the smile at the corner of his mouth turned cruel."Your Highness is right, it's false." "This also shows that Ning Chuan and Tang Yi are at the end of their game." Su Kuang put down the tea cup and respectfully said: "Congratulations, Your Highness, we don't have to do anything. We just wait until the deadline given by His Majesty to solve the case is up, and His Highness will be able to kill three birds with one stone." "Oh? Which three birds?" The prince's eyes narrowed.Su Kuang's face was full of confidence and he said: "First, wipe out Ningchuan. Ningchuan is His Majesty's confidant. If Your Highness wants to control the Jin Yiwei in the future, Ning Chuan must die." "Second, His Highness has removed obstacles for the ministers and made the ministers' accounts in the household department become bad debts. His Majesty couldn't check them if he wanted to. They must be more loyal to Your Highness." "Of course, the most important point is the third point." Su Kuang said with confidence and pride in his smile.: "Yan Wang Xiao Di. Yan Wang Xiao Di has no foundation in the court, but he has many supporters in the army." "And I have a bet with Yi Ji. Whoever solves the case at the Ministry of Revenue first will have to run naked around the city." "If King Yan strips naked and runs around naked outside the city, it will be a joke to the entire Kyoto and a shame to the royal family."Then he will have nothing to do with that position."The prince's hand suddenly stopped, and the tea in the cup overflowed.His originally smiling face suddenly stiffened, and he suddenly looked at Su Kuang, his eyes becoming cold and stern, filled with scrutiny and scrutiny.Although Xiao Di had no foundation in the court, he had high prestige in the army.Many generals in the Beijing army currently guarding Kyoto are related to him and have fought with him on the border to kill enemies.Now, Su Kuang actually said that he could destroy him?The prince stared at Su Kuang with cold eyes. Su Kuang also had a smile on his face and nodded slightly towards the prince.From the beginning, he was not targeting Tang Yi, but King Yan Xiao Di.Tang Yi, just by the way."Your Highness, do you think that with His Highness's character, if he loses, he will default on his debt?" Su Kuang slowly took out the bet signed with Yichu from his arms.But now, Tang Yi and Xiao Di are both from the same place.Hong Zhu immediately stepped forward, took the contract and put it on the prince's desk.The prince looked at the bet carefully, the coldness in his eyes gradually dissipated, and even his heartbeat couldn't help but speed up.Among the princes in the capital now, Xiao Di poses the greatest threat to him. As long as Xiao Di is eradicated, he will be the ninth and fifth prince.And with Xiao Ce's character, as long as he loses, he will definitely not default on his debt.A royal who runs around naked in front of the people of Kyoto will be disallowed by etiquette, despised by the ancestral temple, and abandoned by all officials. What qualifications does he have to compete with him?"If the fourth child loses, he will definitely not default on his debt." The prince motioned to Hong Zhu to return the contract to Su Kuang. He looked at Shu Kuang and said, "The premise is that you must tell Gu first. Why do you think you can win?" Su Kuang put the contract away and said, "I have already found someone.The evidence proves that the former right minister of the Ministry of Revenue paid for the murder because he could not repay the huge debt to the treasury."The murderer was his subordinate in the Ministry of Revenue."The prince took a sip from the tea cup and said, "Liu Gongjin has been keeping a clean life. The Liu family has been in extreme poverty these years. He borrowed the money."What's the use of a huge debt?" Su Kuang laughed and said, "Liu Gongjin has an extra wife.The extra wife is Mei Xiang, a famous courtesan in Huanyin Pavilion in Kyoto.It just so happens that this woman lost all her money in business." "Liu Gongjin embezzled public funds to make up for the loss."He put down the tea cup and said, "That's very good. Let's do what you said!" "If this is done well, I will be rewarded." Su Kuang quickly stood up and cupped his hands and said, "Thank you, Your Highness. I am willing to go through fire and water for Your Highness, no matter what." The prince waved his hand, and Su Kuang turned and left.Immediately, the prince returned to the piano table and gently plucked the strings with his fingertips.The messy but extremely melodious sound of the piano sounded in the hall.This is his common way of thinking about problems. Others like to be quiet when thinking about problems. He always feels uncomfortable if he doesn't have something in his hands when thinking about things.I used to like painting, but which woman in the world could be worthy of him?Therefore, those scrolls only had enchanting figures but no faces.Now, he enjoys playing the piano.Zheng!At this time, the prince's hand suddenly stopped.The originally melodious sound of the piano suddenly became sharper and stopped abruptly.Hong Zhu knew that the prince had made a decision, so he bowed and waited for the order."Tell Liu Wen that it's time for them to pay back the money." Just pay back whatever is on the books.The treasury is running out of money, so the worst thing to do is to raise taxes.The people of the world are, at best, people of Dayan, but at worst, they are just slaves of his Xiao family.A slave should give everything to his master!...Zhuangyuan Street, Zhuangyuan Building.Today, after taking a rest, Liu Wen and a group of civil servants from the court gathered together again in Zhuangyuan Street.Their goal is naturally the elusive little poetry fairy.I just sent people to stay on guard for several days, but there was still no news about the little Shixian.On the contrary, he wrote several masterpieces, which caused a stir."The sparse shadows are slanting across the clear and shallow water, and the faint fragrance is floating in the moonlight at dusk."
